Source. Static parsing of the staged APFS image shows volume-superblock block 106 stores `omap_oid = 101` and `root_tree_oid = 1028`, and OMAP block 101 stores `tree_oid = 102`. This delegating constructor materializes those values together, so the later object-map search is performed on block 102 for oid 1028.

Block 102 is accepted as a root/leaf fixed-key OMAP node (`obj_type = 0x0002`, `subtype = 0x0000000b`, `flags = 0x0007`), but its header also gives `table_space_offset = 0xffff`. `toffset()` therefore becomes `0x38 + 0xffff = 65591`, so `_table_data.toc` is cached 61495 bytes past the end of the 4096-byte `_storage` block. The vulnerable source performs no bounds check here.

The same block-102 header sets `table_space_length = 0x01c0`, so `koffset()` becomes `65591 + 448 = 66039`. `_table_data.koff` is therefore another out-of-block pointer, again stored without any `> _storage.size()` rejection in the vulnerable constructor.
